systems.definition: Repeatable machinery: methodology, templates and developer tooling that made the applications cheaper to build.

items.name: HartStack CLI
items.tagline: Scaffolding tool that generates production-ready full-stack SaaS projects in one command.
items.notes: The scaffold command walks a Handlebars template tree, conditionally including files by filename prefix (__b2b__, __b2c__, __stripe__). The deploy command runs a six-step Azure provisioning flow: validate, create resources, configure secrets, update workflow files, set GitHub secrets, print summary.
